```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggh4x)
library(ggplot2)

pd <- position_dodge(width = 0.5)

corona_topology <- read_tsv("combi_out_ot/corona/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")
hsv_topology <- read_tsv("combi_out_ot/hsv/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")
hiv_topology <- read_tsv("combi_out_ot/hiv/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")

corona_filter <- read_tsv("new_filtered_outputs/corona/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")
hsv_filter <- read_tsv("new_filtered_outputs/hsv/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")
hiv_filter <- read_tsv("new_filtered_outputs/hiv/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")

corona_categories <- read_tsv("category_filter/corona/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")
hsv_categories <- read_tsv("category_filter/hsv/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")
hiv_categories <- read_tsv("category_filter/hiv/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")

corona_categories_viral <- read_tsv("viral_categories/corona/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")
hsv_categories_viral <- read_tsv("viral_categories/hsv/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")
hiv_categories_viral <- read_tsv("viral_categories/hiv/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")

corona_human_strats <- read_tsv("human_strats/corona/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv") %>% filter(str_detect(sample, "top_100"))
hsv_human_strats <- read_tsv("human_strats/hsv/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv") %>% filter(str_detect(sample, "top_100"))
hiv_human_strats <- read_tsv("human_strats/hiv/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv") %>% filter(str_detect(sample, "top_100"))

corona_subcategory <- read_tsv("subcategories_outputs/corona/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")
hsv_subcategory <- read_tsv("subcategories_outputs/hsv/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")
hiv_subcategory <- read_tsv("subcategories_outputs/hiv/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")

corona_interactions <- read_tsv("interaction_filter_outputs/corona/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")
hsv_interactions <- read_tsv("interaction_filter_outputs/hsv/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")
hiv_interactions <- read_tsv("interaction_filter_outputs/hiv/mqc_summaries/topology_mqc.tsv")
```

```{r}
corona_topology <- corona_topology %>% 
  mutate(seed = ifelse(startsWith(sample, "human"), "human", "virus"),
         seed = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "human", seed),
         method = str_extract(sample, "[^\\.]+$"),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "hvidb"), "hvidb", "intact" ),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "open_targets", dataset),
         fill_group = paste(seed, dataset, sep = "_")) %>%
  mutate(group = interaction(seed, dataset, sep = "_"))

hsv_topology <- hsv_topology %>% 
  mutate(seed = ifelse(startsWith(sample, "human"), "human", "virus"),
         seed = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "human", seed),
         method = str_extract(sample, "[^\\.]+$"),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "hvidb"), "hvidb", "intact" ),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "open_targets", dataset),
         fill_group = paste(seed, dataset, sep = "_")) %>%
  mutate(group = interaction(seed, dataset, sep = "_"))

hiv_topology <- hiv_topology %>% 
  mutate(seed = ifelse(startsWith(sample, "human"), "human", "virus"),
         seed = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "human", seed),
         method = str_extract(sample, "[^\\.]+$"),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "hvidb"), "hvidb", "intact" ),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "open_targets", dataset),
         fill_group = paste(seed, dataset, sep = "_")) %>%
  mutate(group = interaction(seed, dataset, sep = "_"))
```

```{r}
corona_filter <- corona_filter %>%
  mutate(seed = ifelse(startsWith(sample, "human"), "human", "virus"),
         seed = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "human", seed),
         method = str_extract(sample, "[^\\.]+$"),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "hvidb"), "hvidb", "intact" ),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "open_targets", dataset),
         fill_group = paste(seed, dataset, sep = "_")) %>%
  mutate(group = interaction(seed, dataset, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(facet = str_extract(sample, "^[^.]+\\.([^.]+)\\.", group = 1),
         facet = fct_relevel(facet, "top_100", after = Inf))

hsv_filter <- hsv_filter %>%
  mutate(seed = ifelse(startsWith(sample, "human"), "human", "virus"),
         seed = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "human", seed),
         method = str_extract(sample, "[^\\.]+$"),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "hvidb"), "hvidb", "intact" ),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "open_targets", dataset),
         fill_group = paste(seed, dataset, sep = "_")) %>%
  mutate(group = interaction(seed, dataset, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(facet = str_extract(sample, "^[^.]+\\.([^.]+)\\.", group = 1),
         facet = fct_relevel(facet, "top_100", after = Inf))

hiv_filter <- hiv_filter %>%
  mutate(seed = ifelse(startsWith(sample, "human"), "human", "virus"),
         seed = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "human", seed),
         method = str_extract(sample, "[^\\.]+$"),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "hvidb"), "hvidb", "intact" ),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "open_targets", dataset),
         fill_group = paste(seed, dataset, sep = "_")) %>%
  mutate(group = interaction(seed, dataset, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(facet = str_extract(sample, "^[^.]+\\.([^.]+)\\.", group = 1),
         facet = fct_relevel(facet, "top_100", after = Inf))
```

```{r}
categories <- c("expansion", "interaction_type", "clinical", "interactive")

corona_viral_strats <- corona_categories_viral %>%
  mutate(seed = ifelse(startsWith(sample, "human"), "human", "virus"),
         seed = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "human", seed),
         method = str_extract(sample, "[^\\.]+$"),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "hvidb"), "hvidb", "intact" ),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "open_targets", dataset),
         fill_group = paste(seed, dataset, sep = "_")) %>%
  mutate(group = interaction(seed, dataset, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(facet = str_extract(sample, paste(categories, collapse = "|"))) %>%
  mutate(facet = recode_values(facet,
                             "interactive" ~ "tractability",
                             default = facet)) %>%
  filter(is.na(facet)) %>%
  mutate(facet = case_when(
    str_detect(sample, "human_int") ~ "viral+human edges",
    str_detect(sample, "standard") ~ "standard",
    .default = "viral edges"
  ))

hsv_viral_strats <- hsv_categories_viral %>%
  mutate(seed = ifelse(startsWith(sample, "human"), "human", "virus"),
         seed = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "human", seed),

         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "hvidb"), "hvidb", "intact" ),
         dataset = ifelse(str_detect(sample, "targets"), "open_targets", dataset),
         fill_group = paste(seed, dataset, sep = "_")) %>%
  mutate(group = interaction(seed, dataset, sep = "_")) %>% 
  mutate(facet = str_extract(sample, paste(categories, collapse = "|"))) %>%
  mutate(facet = recode_values(facet,
                             "interactive" ~ "tractability",
                             default = facet)) %>%
  filter(is.na(facet)) %>%
  mutate(facet = case_when(
    str_detect(sample, "human_int") ~ "viral+human edges",

  ))
```

```{r}
plot_topology <- function(data,
                           fill_values,
                           shape_values = c(
                             "human_hvidb" = 22,
                             "human_intact" = 22,
                             "human_open_targets" = 22,
                             "virus_hvidb" = 24,
                             "virus_intact" = 24
                           ),
                           labels = c(
                             "human_hvidb" = "human, HVIDB",
                             "human_intact" = "human, IntAct",
                             "human_open_targets" = "human, Open Targets",
                             "virus_hvidb" = "virus, HVIDB",
                             "virus_intact" = "virus, IntAct"
                           ),
                           legend_name = "Seed/Dataset",
                           position_dodge_width = 0.8,
                           output_file = NULL,
                           width = 7.29,
                           height = 4.5,
                          virus_facet=FALSE) {

  pd <- position_dodge(width = position_dodge_width)

  p <- data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = method, y = nodes, fill = group, shape = group)) +
    geom_line(
      aes(group = interaction(dataset, method)),
      position = pd,
      color = "grey40"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      position = pd,
      size = 3,
      color = "black",
      aes(group = dataset)
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(name = legend_name, labels = labels, values = fill_values) +
    scale_shape_manual(name = legend_name, labels = labels, values = shape_values) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
  axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 13)
    )+
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE),
    shape = guide_legend(nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE)
  ) + 
    labs(x = "Method", y = "Nodes") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()))
  
  if(virus_facet){
    p <- p + facet_wrap(. ~ virus)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(output_file)) {
    ggsave(output_file, plot = p, height = height, width = width)
  }
  p
}
```

```{r}
                           output_file = NULL,
                           width = 7.29,
                           height = 4.5,
                           nrow = 1,
                           ncol = 3) {

  pd <- position_dodge(width = position_dodge_width)
  
  data <- data %>%
  group_by(dataset, method, facet) %>%
  mutate(n_points = dplyr::n()) %>%
  ungroup()

  p <- data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = method, y = nodes, fill = group, shape = group)) +
    geom_line(
      aes(group = interaction(dataset, method)),
      position = pd,
      color = "grey40"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      position = pd,
      size = 3,
      color = "black",
      aes(group = dataset)
    ) +
    facet_wrap(. ~ facet, ncol = ncol, scales = "free_x") + 
    scale_fill_manual(name = legend_name, labels = labels, values = fill_values) +
    scale_shape_manual(name = legend_name, labels = labels, values = shape_values) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
  axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 13)
    ) + 
    labs(x = "Method", y = "Nodes")  +
    coord_flip(clip = "off") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()),
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 3),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.23))
    ) + 
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(nrow = nrow, byrow = TRUE),
    shape = guide_legend(nrow = nrow, byrow = TRUE)
  )
  

  if (!is.null(output_file)) {
    ggsave(output_file, plot = p, height = height, width = width)
  }
  p
}
```


```{r}
plot_topology_facet2 <- function(data,
                           fill_values,
                           shape_values = c(
                             "human_hvidb" = 22,
                             "human_intact" = 22,
                             "human_open_targets" = 22,
                             "virus_hvidb" = 24,
                             "virus_intact" = 24
                           ),
                           labels = c(
                             "human_hvidb" = "human, HVIDB",
                             "human_intact" = "human, IntAct",
                             "human_open_targets" = "human, Open Targets",
                             "virus_hvidb" = "virus, HVIDB",
                             "virus_intact" = "virus, IntAct"
                           ),
                           legend_name = "Seed/Dataset",
                           position_dodge_width = 0.5,
                           output_file = NULL,
                           width = 7.29,
                           height = 4.5,
                           facet_col = 2,
                           nrow = 1) {

  pd <- position_dodge(width = position_dodge_width)
  
  data <- data %>%
  group_by(dataset, method, facet) %>%
  mutate(n_points = dplyr::n()) %>%
  ungroup()
  
  p <- data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = method, y = nodes, fill = group, shape = group)) +
    geom_line(
      aes(group = interaction(dataset, method)),
      position = pd,
      color = "grey40"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      position = pd,
      size = 3,
      color = "black",
      aes(group = dataset)
    ) +
    facet_wrap2(. ~ dataset+facet, ncol = facet_col, scales = "free_x") + 
    scale_fill_manual(name = legend_name, labels = labels, values = fill_values) +
    scale_shape_manual(name = legend_name, labels = labels, values = shape_values) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
  axis.text  = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
  strip.text = element_text(size = 13)
    )+ 
    labs(x = "Method", y = "Nodes")+ 
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::label_number(scale_cut = scales::cut_short_scale()),
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 3),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))
    )+ 
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(nrow = nrow, byrow = TRUE),
    shape = guide_legend(nrow = nrow, byrow = TRUE)
  )

  if (!is.null(output_file)) {
    ggsave(output_file, plot = p, height = height, width = width)
  }
  p
}
```
